description: A Product Director must approve the initial production rollout policy for a new team-provisioning workflow, including the rollout size, region, account exclusions, notice period, and operating commitments, after the standard launch-readiness review.

shared_context.S1: The new team-provisioning workflow passed functional, accessibility, and staging integration tests.
shared_context.S2: The production account base contains 200 eligible accounts.
shared_context.S3: The draft launch plan proposes enabling the workflow for 10% of eligible accounts across the standard production regions next Tuesday.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the binding decision on the production feature-flag configuration.
shared_context.S5: The standard launch-readiness meeting includes a customer-success review and a platform-capacity review, and the customer-success and platform-capacity leads each give their formal review finding before Maya settles the production configuration.
shared_context.S6: For a single-region rollout, the platform-capacity review uses the measured safe activation limit for that region as the total cohort cap; a separate regional distribution report is not required.

PF1.text: Theo confirmed with legal this morning that Northstar and Pine are covered by a pilot addendum requiring seven calendar days of customer notice before either account is enabled, and neither account has opted in; he has not updated the launch ticket yet because legal confirmed the wording during a separate renewal review.

PF2.text: While reviewing an unrelated queue-capacity graph today, Rina measured that the provisioning service can safely handle exactly 12 new-account activations in us-east during the next Tuesday window; the draft's 20-account, multi-region plan would exceed the queue limit, and she has not filed the capacity note yet.

acceptance_conditions: The workflow must be enabled next Tuesday.
The rollout must include exactly 12 accounts.
The rollout region must be us-east.
Northstar and Pine must both be excluded from the rollout.
Customer notice must be set to exactly 7 calendar days.
A commitment documenting the us-east capacity limit of 12 activations must be recorded.
A commitment documenting the seven-day customer notice requirement for Northstar and Pine must be recorded.
The customer notice requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any('capacity' in c['detail'] and '12' in c['detail'] and 'us-east' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('notice' in c['detail'] and ('7' in c['detail'] or 'seven' in c['detail']) and 'Northstar' in c['detail'] and 'Pine' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The ordinary 20-account launch has no named exclusions or notice period; PF1 changes the excluded-account list to exactly Northstar and Pine, sets notice to exactly 7 days, and requires a commitment documenting that notice requirement.
The draft 10% rollout means 20 accounts across standard regions; PF2 changes the safe configuration to exactly 12 accounts in us-east and requires a commitment documenting the us-east capacity limit.
